title: Lip Sync for Your Legacy debuts
summary: All Stars 2 replaced Lip Sync for Your Life with Lip Sync for Your Legacy: the top two challenge winners lip-synced, and the winner earned $10,000 and chose which bottom queen to eliminate (starting in AS-S02-E01).

title: Adore Delano quits
summary: During All Stars Snatch Game (AS-S02-E02), Adore Delano withdrew from the competition before the runway, leaving nine queens.

title: Shut Up and Drive double return
summary: In Revenge of the Queens (AS-S02-E05), eliminated queens returned for a comedy challenge. Alyssa Edwards and Tatianna both won the lip-sync to Rihanna's "Shut Up and Drive," re-entered, and eliminated Phi Phi O'Hara.

title: Alaska wins All Stars 2
summary: In All Stars Supergroup (AS-S02-E08), Roxxxy Andrews was eliminated on the runway. Alaska, Detox, and Katya lip-synced to "If I Were Your Woman"; Alaska was crowned and entered the Drag Race Hall of Fame with a $100,000 prize.
